title: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon — FAQ (2026/2027 edition)
claims: The 42.2 km Sanlam Cape Town Marathon has two starts: the Stadium start on Fritz Sonnenberg Road next to the stadium, and the Beach Road start on Beach Road in Mouille Point.
The finish for all events is on Vlei Road.
The 42.2 km route has 15 hydration stations approximately 3 km apart; 13 serve water, Coke, Coke No Sugar and Powerade, and 2 serve water only.
Hydration packs are permitted, but earphones or headphones of any description are not permitted.
The 42.2 km marathon cut-off is 6.5 hours, with all cut-off times shown on the route map.
The marathon is timed gun-to-mat for elites and mat-to-mat for all other participants.
The marathon age limit is 18 years on race day.
All entries are non-transferable and running in another runner's bib leads to disqualification.
The 2027 marathon is scheduled for 23 May 2027.
